Registered for the record when Markus says yes and LEAGUE_VERSION goes to 1 at the lock (about 12-13 Dec 2026); after that nothing here changes (a change = a new dated strategy).
source_document: docs/plans/fund-roadmap-2026-11-17.md Phase 1 (agreed by Markus 17 Nov 2026); code research_harness/league/families.py
hypothesis: Do weekly re-entry and a sector cap help momentum?
rules: As S-MOMO, with two changes: (1) after a brake exit, re-entry also at the first session of each week if the index is back above its 100-session average; (2) at most 12 of the 50 names (25%) from one sector, taking the next-ranked names instead. Sectors as the S&P 500 holdings file states them (free; same download).
rebalance_day: first session of each month + brake changes + weekly re-entry
leverage: no borrowing: weights add to at most 100% (max_gross 1.0). Effective exposure above 1x only through 2x funds.
fills: decision after a session close, filled at the next session's open (twins engine = research_harness/harness/portfolio.simulate)
costs: one shared model for every line: twins.config.SHARE_COSTS = 0 commission, 2 bps half spread, 3 bps slippage per trade (estimates; monthly re-measure from the real accounts' fills is a later work order). Gearing only through 2x funds (SSO, QLD), whose borrowing cost is inside their price; no margin. Idle money in BIL (T-bills); plain cash earns 0.
data_needed: as S-MOMO + the holdings file's Sector column
window: forward only: version 1 from the first session after the lock to 31 Dec 2027 (roadmap Phase 2). No backtest stands behind this line in the league.
prior_variants_tried: as S-MOMO; the two changes are new
pass_bar: Roadmap Phase 4 (January 2028): passes if, after costs, it matched or beat the S&P 500 (Y-SPX), or came close with a clearly smaller worst fall, AND passes the luck check adjusted for 16 tries (deflated Sharpe: research_harness/harness/overfit.deflated_sharpe with n_trials = 16). The exact 'came close' and 'clearly smaller' numbers are UNKNOWN: Markus to fix them before version 1 starts.
